agreements.name: MFN (WTO)
agreements.partners: All countries without an applicable FTA/PTA
agreements.commitment: Standard/statutory BCD
agreements.exclusions: AIDC, anti-dumping and safeguard duties apply in addition where notified
agreements.source: CBIC working tariff / Notif. 45/2025-Customs as amended

agreements.name: India-ASEAN FTA (AIFTA)
agreements.partners: Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Lao PDR, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam
agreements.commitment: 0% on the Normal Track by 2016; Sensitive Track cut to 5%; ~489 lines in India's Exclusion List
agreements.exclusions: Agri (Ch 1-24), petroleum (Ch 27) and motor vehicles (8701-8706) treated as excluded; Sensitive-Track lines may attract 5% instead of 0%.
agreements.roo: RVC 35% + CTSH (general); product-specific rules for chemicals, textiles, steel, etc.

agreements.name: India-UAE CEPA
agreements.commitment: 0% on ~80% of lines immediately, ~90% within 10 years; TRQs for dates, copper, etc.
agreements.modelled: Yes - line-level rates for the agri subset from public dataset; remainder derived by chapter rule
agreements.exclusions: Agri lines use the published CEPA rate where available; other Ch 1-24 lines and motor vehicles treated as excluded.
agreements.roo: RVC 40% or CTSH (product-specific rules in Annex 3B)

agreements.name: India-Japan CEPA
agreements.commitment: ~90% of industrial lines at 0% by 2021; agri excluded
agreements.exclusions: Agri (Ch 1-24) and motor vehicles treated as excluded; some industrial lines remain in the negative list.

agreements.name: India-Korea CEPA
agreements.commitment: 0% on ~85% of lines by 2021; agri excluded
agreements.exclusions: Agri (Ch 1-24) and motor vehicles treated as excluded; sensitive industrial lines may carry 5%.

agreements.name: India-Australia ECTA
agreements.commitment: India: duty-free on 40.3% of lines immediately, a further ~30% phased to zero; TRQs/exclusions for dairy, cereals, sugar, apples, walnuts, chickpeas
agreements.exclusions: Ch 1-24 treated as excluded (several are TRQ/staged rather than fully excluded).

agreements.name: India-Mauritius CECPA
agreements.commitment: Line-specific concessions on ~615 tariff lines (textiles, footwear, processed food, some engineering goods)
agreements.modelled: No - line-specific list not modelled (MFN shown)
agreements.exclusions: Only listed lines get a concession. Cells show MFN as a conservative placeholder - verify against the CECPA schedule.

agreements.name: India-Sri Lanka ISFTA
agreements.commitment: 0% on all lines except India's Negative List (~429 lines)
agreements.exclusions: Agri treated as excluded; the actual Negative List is line-specific.
agreements.roo: WO / 35% domestic value addition; direct consignment

agreements.name: SAFTA
agreements.partners: Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka
agreements.commitment: 0% for LDC/Non-LDC members by 2013 except country-specific Sensitive Lists (~614 lines for India)
agreements.exclusions: Sensitive Lists differ by partner and are line-specific; chapter-level approximation only.
agreements.roo: RVC 40% + CTSH; SAPTA/SAFTA certificate of origin

agreements.name: India-Singapore CECA
agreements.commitment: 0% on almost all lines; a small negative list
agreements.exclusions: Agri treated as excluded; some lines remain dutiable.

agreements.name: India-Malaysia MICECA
agreements.commitment: 0% on most lines; agri and autos excluded
agreements.exclusions: Agri and motor vehicles treated as excluded.

agreements.name: India-Nepal Treaty of Trade
agreements.commitment: Duty-free on most industrial goods; agri/primary goods largely excluded
agreements.exclusions: Agri treated as excluded; negative list is line-specific.
agreements.roo: Certificate of origin; wholly obtained / substantial transformation

agreements.name: India-Bhutan Agreement on Trade, Commerce and Transit
agreements.commitment: Duty-free on most goods of Bhutanese origin
agreements.exclusions: Agri treated as excluded; a small list remains dutiable.

agreements.name: India-EFTA TEPA
agreements.commitment: 100% of non-agricultural lines to 0% (staged 5-10 years); limited processed-agri concessions; agri excluded
agreements.exclusions: Agri excluded; industrial lines are staged, so the current tranche rate may be higher than the 0% shown.

agreements.name: India-UK CETA
agreements.commitment: Duty-free access on 99% of India's exports to the UK; India's concessions staged
agreements.exclusions: Agri treated as excluded; staged lines may be at a higher current-tranche rate.
agreements.source: CBIC Notif. 29/2026-Customs; Commerce Ministry FTA list

agreements.name: India-Oman CEPA
agreements.commitment: Broad tariff elimination, staged
agreements.exclusions: Agri and motor vehicles treated as excluded; staged lines may be at a higher current-tranche rate.

agreements.name: India-New Zealand FTA
agreements.commitment: India cuts/eliminates on ~95% of lines; dairy protected, sensitive agri excluded
agreements.exclusions: Agri (especially dairy, Ch 4) treated as excluded; staged lines may be at a higher current-tranche rate.

agreements.name: India-Chile PTA
agreements.commitment: Line-specific margin of preference on ~178 lines
agreements.modelled: No - line-specific list not modelled (MFN shown)
agreements.exclusions: Only listed lines get a concession; MFN shown as a conservative placeholder.

agreements.name: India-Mercosur PTA
agreements.commitment: Margin of preference on ~450 lines
agreements.modelled: No - line-specific list not modelled (MFN shown)
agreements.exclusions: Only listed lines get a concession; MFN shown as a conservative placeholder.

agreements.name: Asia-Pacific Trade Agreement (APTA)
agreements.partners: Bangladesh, China, India, Lao PDR, Republic of Korea, Sri Lanka, Mongolia
agreements.commitment: Margin of preference (typically 10-50%) on scheduled lines
agreements.modelled: No - line-specific schedules not modelled (MFN shown)
agreements.exclusions: Only scheduled lines get a concession; MFN shown as a conservative placeholder.
agreements.roo: Direct consignment; APTA certificate of origin

agreements.name: Global System of Trade Preferences (GSTP)
agreements.partners: ~40 developing countries (incl. Brazil, Egypt, Indonesia, Iran, Malaysia, Mexico, Nigeria, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Zimbabwe, etc.)
agreements.commitment: Margin of preference on negotiated lines
agreements.modelled: No - line-specific schedules not modelled (MFN shown)
agreements.exclusions: Only negotiated lines get a concession; MFN shown as a conservative placeholder.
agreements.roo: Direct consignment; GSTP certificate of origin
